svg.title: Strong and weak Stackelberg payoffs in the commitment game

cc:Work.dc:title: Strong and weak Stackelberg payoffs in the commitment game
cc:Work.dc:description: Follower utilities p for c and 1-p for d intersect at p=1/2. Strong tie-breaking attains 7/2 there; weak tie-breaking gives 3/2 there and has the unattained supremum 7/2.
